semanticRules.status: candidate-only; no shape validation or hand expectation demonstrates product acceptance/authentication/transaction/SQL/HTTP
semanticRules.scope: initial bridge adapters: saved confirmed-play undo and existing confirmed play continuation. Same-request U2 cancellation remains a normative reference, not a provided native bridge variant; retain existing generic kernel behavior. No unknown control/profile success, no future lifecycle registration; existing known unsupported kinds stay unsupported without blocking this unit.
semanticRules.encoding: All checkpoint/pure integer leaves canonical decimal strings with strict EOS, no new digit or stack length cap. Existing HTTP d1/target d1 use strict integer JSON safe range 1..9007199254740991 (bool/float are not wire integers). No coercion, missing/null distinction, unknown properties/duplicate keys/nonfinite tokens rejected. Schema shape does not encode all semantic correlations.
semanticRules.identity: Event itself never transports tenantId (V1). Source tenant comes only from authenticated issuer/game ownership, not caller claims. V10 game+D4+D1 resolves a saved original, matches exact activeStack[0].play.source. OwnD4 may differ from targetD4: require genuine DB generation linkage and exact target tuple; never substitute ownD4 for targetD4.
semanticRules.checkpointDigest: ref.digest = lower hex SHA256 of UTF8 JSON of content only, recursively key-sorted ensure_ascii=False compact separators and finite values (existing first_ball_projection._canonical_json / idempotency.source_fingerprint encoding). No ref in preimage. Hash alone never issues qualification. Ref id/revision/digest must match locked real checkpoint, expectedCheckpoint all members equal; all updates use CAS.
semanticRules.heads: d3 is current generation contiguous slot watermark. d1Head null iff d3=0; otherwise exact final accepted current-generation event at d3 with original D5/fingerprint. A cancelled-slot latest watermark requires another explicitly adopted carrier variant and is not admitted by this Source schema. projectionHead references latest state-applied event or actual started origin; it is not inferred from d3/activeHead. activeHead null iff activeDepth=0; else exact full activeStack[0].play with eventKind play_input. Undo itself never appears in active stack; it has no own D2/V6 or V8/V9/V11.
semanticRules.history: activeDepth == activeStack.length. Each frame is a read-only derived view of immutable accepted original/state_diff and confirmed undo exclusions, not a mutable second history authority. Complete stack, exact order, no duplicate event/play identity, each genuine source/raw fingerprint and target proof must be verified. calculation.request.history.stack equals all historyEntry values in same order; request.current equals checkpoint.restored.current; head after/current correspondence and tail representation use unchanged applyUndo contract.
semanticRules.restore: Successful undo calls unique accepted artifact applyUndo exactly once on genuine source. Entire response matches submitted calculation (type-preserving all values); require applied/pops1, after equals genuine head.beforeContext.current, tail preserved. checkpoint.restored becomes genuine head.beforeContext full current/rules/lineup/participants/runners/responsibility/T2/digests, not inferred from just ball count. Adjacent active frame before/after contexts must correspond to genuine sequence. For undone-to-initial active empty restore real initial context while d3/projection remain undo, never started/D3=0 spoof.
semanticRules.versions: New CP ref revision is expected+1 per committed bridge mutation. historyVersion identifies new derived wire snapshot and advances, storageHistoryEpoch changes only with real storage rewrite; neither equals D3/depth/ref revision by definition. nextPhysicalPlayNumber comes from preserved physical max+1 under lock, not active depth/D1/D2. Saved-play undo creates no play row and never reuses old physical numbers. D2 remains separate allocator output; example values 1024/2048/3072 are not physical numbers or D1.
semanticRules.atomicQualification: Real E1 source/rights/device/recovery binding, live same writer+handle+Session+top-level TX, currentXID/nonce and unexpired one-use opaque frame are runtime prerequisites, never JSON boolean attestations. Consumer rechecks exact fixed operation/SQL/all binds/actual source/frame identity and CAS. SQL rechecks accepted original/ledger/slot/target-active proof, no fake play_row_id/source_d2; old CHECK/defaultdeny remain. Any failure rolls back ledger,event,slot,D3,target logical cancellation,checkpoint,history,canonical S and invalidations; no catches that turn host errors into content success.
semanticRules.DI: After existing authentication, D5 is classified before V12/fresh CP/frame/source checks. Same D5+same full original -> stored result candidate, no re-evaluation/pop/rows/version updates. Same D5 different content -> existing B3b, no new result. Replay A5 carries saved result while GET/current checkpoint remains latest; no rollback to saved checkpoint. External mixed A5 follows DI5 first B2/B3 stop, later preclassified entries remain unprocessed. No new rejection order/ACK result format invented.
semanticRules.U2: Saved target -> apply actual saved undo. Target in same-request contiguous prefix -> cancel before either operation is applied; persist both D5 cancellation results atomically, advance confirmed slots, no new play/state apply; immutable originals and both cancellation results remain auditable. Audit operation_events carrier is a later fixed SQL design, not decided by this shape. A cancelled-slot technical carrier is a proposal only, excluded from the first Source success type until durable references/SQL/atomic qualification are adopted. Native bridge dispatch must not pretend it is accepted; existing generic kernel cancellation behavior is unchanged. True absent gap -> B2 unprocessed, neither target nor undo saved, no D5 reservation/wait across requests/drain. Stored replay bypasses this classification; empty local history U4 generates no event or D1.
semanticRules.S: Canonical S uses genuine accepted originals + verified undo target/cancellation/exclusion watermark. Only verified cancelled plays are excluded; arbitrary hidden/corrupt source remains unavailable/error. Undo adds no new primitive pitch fact. Source/nonce/TX/frame plus S selector/generated SQL are later runtime dependencies; these fixtures do not prove stats delivery, global D11 or real product reach.
semanticRules.limits: Unit1 undo contract3/host/TS/math remain immutable. New restoration fields reuse existing no-change responsibility and existing closed types; unsupported substitution/reset/lifecycle cases do not silently succeed. Real API/P1/source/SQL/next GET/stats and unit1+2 D11 composition are later acceptance, not additional PO/all-operation start gates.
